topics.topic: A day on Venus is longer than its year; Venus spins backwards
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid
The Zeigarnik effect: unfinished tasks are remembered better
Orionid meteor shower is dust from Halley's Comet (peaks Oct 21-22, ~66 km/s)
Octopuses have three hearts and blue copper-based blood; systemic heart stops when swimming
Astronauts grow up to 3% taller in space
First parachute jump: Garnerin, Paris, Oct 22 1797 (silk parachute from balloon)
Vampire bats regurgitate/share blood meals with hungry roostmates, incl. non-kin
Bananas are slightly radioactive (potassium-40, banana equivalent dose)
Mole Day (Oct 23, 6:02-6:02) and Avogadro's number 6.02x10^23; a mole of water is ~18 g
First jack-o'-lanterns were carved from turnips (Ireland/Scotland) and beets (England); pumpkins in America
Sugar-cube of neutron star weighs ~1 billion tons; ~20 km wide; spin hundreds of times/sec
First person over Niagara Falls in a barrel: Annie Edson Taylor, Oct 24 1901, her 63rd birthday (cat tested barrel first)
Owls can't move their tubular eyes; rotate heads ~270 degrees; 14 neck vertebrae vs 7 in humans
Clocks go back Oct 25 2026 in Europe (US Nov 1); Germany first nationwide DST in 1916 to save fuel in WWI; Franklin's 1784 joke essay
Statue of Liberty was originally shiny copper; unveiled Oct 28 1886; copper ~2 pennies thick; green patina from ~1903, fully green ~1920; 1906 paint plan dropped; patina protects
Félicette, first cat in space: Oct 18 1963, French Véronique rocket from Algeria, >150 km, ~5 min weightless, 13 min flight, recovered; statue 2019
Pumpkins are botanical berries (pepo) like watermelons/cucumbers; bananas, tomatoes are berries; strawberries/raspberries are not
Smallpox: only human disease eradicated; last natural case Ali Maow Maalin, Merca Somalia, rash Oct 26 1977; WHO certified eradication Oct 26 1979; he later volunteered for polio
Crows remember human faces (UW Seattle caveman-mask study, Marzluff); untrapped and young crows learned to scold; 20%->60% at one site after 5 years
Mars sunsets are blue (dust forward-scatters blue light); photographed by Curiosity/Opportunity; daytime sky butterscotch
NYC subway opened Oct 27 1904 (IRT, 9.1 mi, 28 stations, nickel fare); Mayor McClellan drove first train to 103rd St; 100k+ riders first evening
Wood frogs freeze solid in winter: up to 60% of body ice, heart/breathing stop, up to 7 months in Alaska, glucose antifreeze
Goosebumps: arrector pili muscles raise hairs; fur insulation/look bigger in animals; sympathetic (fight-or-flight) so emotions trigger it; likely evolutionary leftover in humans
First ARPANET message Oct 29 1969: UCLA (Charley Kline) to SRI, 'LOGIN' crashed after 'LO'; full login ~1 hour later
War of the Worlds radio broadcast Oct 30 1938 (Orson Welles): mass panic largely a newspaper myth; Hooper survey ~2% listening; most on Chase and Sanborn Hour
Skull-shaped asteroid 2015 TB145 flew by Oct 31 2015 at ~1.3 lunar distances, ~600 m wide, likely dead comet (Arecibo radar)

Houdini died Halloween Oct 31 1926 in Detroit (100th anniversary 2026); secret code 'Rosabelle... believe' with wife Bess; she held Halloween séances 10 years, last 1936 Knickerbocker Hotel rooftop; tradition continues
Mantis shrimp punch ~50 mph, <3 ms, up to 10,000 g; cavitation bubbles boil water, second impact, flashes of light; broke 1/4-inch aquarium glass (1998)
Saturn is the only planet less dense than water (~0.69 g/cm3); NASA 'float in a bathtub' joke; ~9x Earth's width; would fall apart (no solid surface)
Halloween is a cross-quarter day (midway between autumn equinox and winter solstice); Celtic Samhain 'summer's end', new year; true midpoint early Nov; Groundhog Day, May Day, Lammas
Bats aren't blind: all species can see; flying foxes rely on big eyes, many can't echolocate; microbats use vision for distant landmarks; some UV vision
Recreational fear sweet spot: Aarhus Univ (Andersen et al., Psychological Science) 110 people in Vejle Denmark haunted house; enjoyment and heart rate inverted-U
Candy corn: 1880s Philadelphia, credited to George Renninger (Wunderle Candy Co.); sold as 'Chicken Feed' with rooster box; made by hand; Halloween icon after late-1940s trick-or-treating
Apollo footprints on the Moon could last millions of years: no wind/rain, no volcanoes; only slow solar-particle wear or meteorite hit; 12 moonwalkers 1969-1972
Face pareidolia: Hadjikhani et al. 2009 NeuroReport MEG study, face-like objects activate fusiform face area at ~165 ms (faces ~130/170 ms); ordinary objects do not
Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling standing on scaffolding, not lying on his back (myth from 1965 film The Agony and the Ecstasy); 1508-1512; first shown to public Nov 1 1512
Koala fingerprints nearly indistinguishable from human prints (Henneberg, Adelaide, 1990s); only non-primates with them; convergent evolution; likely for gripping
HD 189733b: blue gas giant ~63 light-years away; blue likely from silicate (glass) particles; glass rain blown sideways by ~7000 km/h winds; >1000 C
ISS continuously occupied since Nov 2 2000 (Expedition 1: Shepherd, Gidzenko, Krikalev, ~4.5 months); 26 years in 2026; ~298 people from 26 countries; ~16 orbits/day
Tutankhamun tomb: first step found Nov 4 1922 as Carnarvon was about to stop funding; Carter 'wonderful things' Nov 26 1922; >5,000 objects; ~10 years to clear
Frequency illusion / Baader-Meinhof phenomenon: 1994 St. Paul Pioneer Press reader letter (Terry Mullen); Arnold Zwicky named it 2005; selective attention + confirmation bias
Sea otters have the densest fur of any animal: 500,000-1,000,000 hairs per sq inch (Seattle Aquarium); no blubber; eat ~25% of body weight daily

Sandwich named after John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich; 1762 gaming-table story from a French travel book (likely apocryphal, Britannica); Cook named Sandwich Islands (Hawaii) 1778; National Sandwich Day Nov 3

Humans emit faint visible light (ultraweak photon emission): Kobayashi & Okamura 2009 PLoS ONE; ~1000x weaker than eye can detect; peak ~4pm, low ~10am; face brightest; metabolic free-radical reactions

Gunpowder Plot 1605: ~36 barrels under House of Lords; Monteagle letter; Fawkes caught near midnight 4-5 Nov with fuse and watch; Yeomen of the Guard ceremonially search cellars before State Opening; Bonfire Night Nov 5
Neptune completed its first orbit since discovery (Galle, Sept 23 1846) in July 2011; ~165-year orbit; ~30 AU (NASA)
You can't tickle yourself: cerebellum predicts and dampens self-produced touch (Blakemore, UCL); robot experiment, delay makes self-tickle feel more ticklish
Taurid meteor shower "Halloween fireballs": South Taurids peak Nov 5 2026, North Nov 12; Comet Encke (shortest orbit of major comets); slow, ~5/hr, larger debris makes fireballs (EarthSky, RMG)

X-rays discovered by Wilhelm Röntgen Nov 8 1895 (Würzburg); barium platinocyanide screen glowed; named X for unknown; wife's hand with ring X-ray Dec 22 1895; first Nobel Physics 1901; no patent (Britannica)

Wombats poop cubes: shape forms in the intestine (~10 m long) via stiff and flexible wall sections (Georgia Tech/Univ. Tasmania, Soft Matter 2021; 2019 Ig Nobel Physics); placed on rocks/logs to communicate

Marie Curie (born Nov 7 1867, Warsaw): first woman Nobel, only person to win in two sciences; radium-contaminated notebooks kept in lead-lined boxes at Bibliotheque nationale de France; Ra-226 half-life ~1600 yrs
Tardigrades survived 10 days exposed to open space on FOTON-M3 (Sept 2007; Jonsson et al., Current Biology 2008); revived, some laid eggs that hatched; tun state
Alaska is northernmost, westernmost and easternmost US state: Aleutians cross 180th meridian (Semisopochnoi Island in Eastern Hemisphere)
